findings_addressed.oracle: Python standard library: bytes([0x80, 0xFF, 0xFE, 0xC0, 0x80]).decode('utf-8', errors='replace') — computes the WHATWG-spec replacement-character string independently of the Rust encoding_rs library used in production. Both follow the same per-byte U+FFFD substitution policy so the oracle and production code must agree exactly.
